Golub Group Llc increased its stake in Chipotle Mexican Grill Inc (CMG) by 17.2% based on its latest 2017Q4 regulatory filing with the SEC. Golub Group Llc bought 14,405 shares as the company’s stock rose 9.39% while stock markets declined. The institutional investor held 98,135 shares of the consumer services company at the end of 2017Q4, valued at $28.36M, up from 83,730 at the end of the previous reported quarter. Golub Group Llc who had been investing in Chipotle Mexican Grill Inc for a number of months, seems to be bullish on the $12.06B market cap company. The stock increased 0.44% or $1.91 during the last trading session, reaching $433.86. About 412,500 shares traded. Chipotle Mexican Grill, Inc. (NYSE:CMG) has declined 22.17% since May 22, 2017 and is downtrending. It has underperformed by 33.72% the S&P500.
